answer.summary: The Enclave is one medium ring-laid town inside your claim: a conclave hall and an inn in the central hub, and around them seven school towers (fire, water, death, enchantment, nature, alchemy, astral). A library and three apprentice dwellings sit on the ring too. Each tower gets its own palette in the style that follows, tied together by a common stone base. Nothing here has to wait.
